description: A shell script for one-time setup of rootless OpenClaw in Podman, including building or pulling images, configuring environment variables, generating tokens, setting up configuration files, and optionally installing systemd systemd service via Quadlet.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in PATH, outputs error and exits if not.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the current user is root.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr and exits.

methods.name: validate_single_line_value
methods.description: Ensures a string does not contain control characters.

methods.name: validate_absolute_path
methods.description: Checks if a path is absolute, has no repeated slashes or dot segments.

methods.name: validate_mount_source_path
methods.description: Validates a path as an absolute path without colon in source.

methods.name: validate_container_name
methods.description: Validates container name against allowed pattern.

methods.name: validate_image_name
methods.description: Validates image name format and disallows certain transport prefixes.

methods.name: ensure_safe_existing_dir
methods.description: Checks if directory exists, is not a symlink.

methods.name: stat_uid
methods.description: Gets UID of a file or directory.

methods.name: stat_mode
methods.description: Gets permission mode of a file or directory.

methods.name: ensure_private_existing_dir_owned_by_user
methods.description: Ensures directory is owned by current user and not group-writable.

methods.name: ensure_safe_write_file_path
methods.description: Checks if file path is safe for writing.

methods.name: write_file_atomically
methods.description: Writes data to a file atomically with specified permissions.

methods.name: validate_port
methods.description: Checks if port is numeric and within valid range.

methods.name: escape_sed_replacement_pipe_delim
methods.description: Escapes special characters for sed replacement.

methods.name: resolve_user_home
methods.description: Resolves the home directory of a user.

methods.name: generate_token_hex_32
methods.description: Generates a 32-byte hex token using available tools.

methods.name: seed_local_control_ui_origins
methods.description: Seeds allowed origins in a JSON config file for local control UI.

methods.name: upsert_env_var
methods.description: Sets or updates an environment variable in a file.
